description: This PHP script handles network diagnostic actions such as pinging IPv4/IPv6 addresses and performing traceroutes, responding with JSON results.

methods.name: test_connectivity
methods.description: Handles ICMP ping test to a specified destination address, returning success status.

methods.name: destination_ipv4
methods.description: Performs IPv4 ping test and returns connectivity status.

methods.name: destination_ipv6
methods.description: Performs IPv6 ping test and returns connectivity status.

methods.name: trace_ipv4_dst
methods.description: Performs IPv4 traceroute to a specified destination and returns hop details.

methods.name: trace_ipv6_dst
methods.description: Performs IPv6 traceroute to a specified destination and returns hop details.
